descFull: Run large AI chat models privately on your own NVIDIA RTX 50 or RTX PRO graphics card. On one RTX 5090, Qwen3.8-27B writes about 70 words per second, 1.4x faster than vLLM. Even a model almost four times larger than the card's memory runs. Works with apps made for ChatGPT or Claude. Starts with one docker command.
